messages:
michael: Heads-up: nightly staging canary failed during attestation step after tonight's keystore rotation. Attest hook exits with "key disabled" and we get no signer id in audit. Logs below. @oncall assigning to incident if it persists.

anya: can you paste the log snippet?

michael: snip from init-hook:
```
2026-05-04T02:11:03Z attest-hook: calling KMS.AsymmetricDecrypt key=projects/keystore-prod/locations/global/keyRings/signers/cryptoKeys/image-signer/cryptoKeyVersions/3
2026-05-04T02:11:03Z kms: error: PERMISSION_DENIED: CryptoKeyVersion 3 is DISABLED
2026-05-04T02:11:03Z attest-hook: attach_signer failed: reason="key_version_disabled"
2026-05-04T02:11:03Z audit: signer_id=""
```

ravi: Uh. We rotated key versions at 02:00 and disabled old versions as part of the hardening playbook. Looks like the builder pipeline was still referencing v3 explicitly. It should use the "primary" alias (no version) to avoid this.

michael: confirm: the image build manifest contains an explicit key-version annotation: "kms_key_version:projects/.../cryptoKeyVersions/3". That was added by a pipeline script change last week.

anya: immediate mitigation options: (A) re-enable v3 for a short window: `gcloud kms keys versions enable 3 --key=image-signer --keyring=signers --location=global --project=keystore-prod` (B) rebuild images referencing the primary key name (preferred but slower) (C) allow attestation to fall back to a signed digest without KMS check for canaries only (not allowed for prod).

ravi: also check RBAC: if builder SA didn't have access to the new key version that would be a different error (403). This is a 410-style failure because version is disabled. good news: not RBAC. still likely we should add a CI guard to prevent pinned-version annotations.

sec-bot: vuln-scan/hardening: keystore rotation completed; policy audit flagged two build manifests that reference explicit key versions. Recommendation: block deployments with explicit version annotations.

michael: I'm going to enable v3 for 15 minutes and re-run the canary. Will post command and ticket.

oncall: INC-2499 opened: https://tickets.internal/INC-2499  oncall will coordinate.

michael: re-enabled v3: 
```
gcloud kms keys versions enable 3 --project=keystore-prod --location=global --keyring=signers --key=image-signer
```
restarted canary -> canary-ptx-18 started.

deploy-bot: rollout-monitor: canary-ptx-18 -> FAILED (attest_hook exit 2). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/rollouts/ptx-18 :x:

anya: what changed? did the enable not propagate? check key state and audit entry for the decrypt call.

ravi: ran a quick check: `gcloud kms keys versions describe 3 --key=image-signer --keyring=signers --location=global --project=keystore-prod` shows state=ENABLED. But audit shows the decrypt call referencing a different project path: projects/keystore-staging/... not keystore-prod. Oh — the canary used a staging keystore because environment variables point to KEYS_PROJECT=${ENV}_keystore. The staging key v3 was disabled and we only re-enabled prod v3.

michael: argh. pipeline env mismatch. So two failures: pinned version + cross-project keystore env.

anya: mitigation now: 1) re-enable staging v3 for 30m 2) update pipeline to stop pinning versions and use key resource name without version 3) add an alert in keystore rotation runbook to check for manifests that embed versions and for env mismatches 4) add a nightly IAM/audit scan that fails builds if key versions referenced are disabled.

ravi: quick commands to re-enable staging v3: 
```
gcloud kms keys versions enable 3 --project=keystore-staging --location=global --keyring=signers --key=image-signer
```
I'll run it and post when done.

oncall: created INC-2500 to track the staging re-enable and pipeline fixes: https://tickets.internal/INC-2500 

ravi: staging v3 enabled. re-run canary.

deploy-bot: rollout-monitor: canary-ptx-18 -> SUCCESS :white_check_mark: 

michael: thanks. next steps: (A) pipeline PR to remove explicit key-version annotation and use primary key name (B) CI preflight: fail if manifest contains regex "cryptoKeyVersions/\d+" (C) update rotation runbook to include a manifest search & env verification step before disabling versions (D) add audit event when signer_attach fails with a specific reason so triage is fast (e.g. signer_attach_failed:key_version_disabled).

anya: +1. I'll open the PRs and the CI check. ravi please add a note to keystore runbook for manifest grep.

ravi: adding note now. Also flagging we should check audit retention — we need at least 30 days for rotation forensic. If customers need longer we should document where to look.

oncall: closing INC-2499 and INC-2500 after verification; leaving postmortem ticket PT-104 for follow-up.

michael: posting diffs and the PR link here once created. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
